changes.text: members only see the libraries their account on each media server can open
automation history no longer fails to load when a run is about a library item
an item the media server re-creates no longer shows twice until the next full scan
poster cache warming skips images the server can't serve instead of backing off as if the server were down
the Seerr card picks up a new Seerr version on the next sync instead of staying on the one it was added with
syncing a Plex, Jellyfin or Emby server refreshes its shown version instead of waiting up to six hours
